why: The [BLOCKING] comment names the seeded bug. It says pick_courier makes a decision from the CourierView, which lags the store, which breaks the 'display only' rule. It also says a stale last order can chain a new order to a courier who isn't really going there, and attach_order succeeds because it only checks capacity. The review's other finding is a nit; since this is a bug PR, no comment counts as a false alarm.
